zh: 他全面介绍了这个计划。
pinyin: Tā quánmiàn jièshào le zhège jìhuà.
en: He gave a comprehensive introduction to this plan.

zh: 公司全面支持这个计划。
pinyin: Gōngsī quánmiàn zhīchí zhège jìhuà.
en: The company fully supports this plan.

zh: 这份报告全面说明了市场情况。
pinyin: Zhè fèn bàogào quánmiàn shuōmíng le shìchǎng qíngkuàng.
en: This report comprehensively explains the market situation.

pinyin: Lǎoshī zhǐchū le wǒ de cuòwù.
en: The teacher pointed out my mistake.

pinyin: Tā zhǎochū le wèntí de yuányīn.
en: He found out the reason for the problem.

zh: 她从包里拿出了一本书。
pinyin: Tā cóng bāo lǐ ná chū le yī běn shū.
en: She took a book out of her bag.

pinyin: Wǒ mǎshàng jiù rènchū le tā.
en: I recognized him right away.
